title: Half-degree irreducible binary polynomials exist through degree 400
statement: For every integer n with 1 <= n <= 400, there exists a monic irreducible polynomial f in GF(2)[x] of degree n such that deg(f - x^n) <= floor(n/2). This is a finite statement only; it does not assert the conjecture for n > 400.

evidence.supports: exactly one monic irreducible half-degree witness for every degree in the inclusive range 1 through 400, with the formal certificate-spec object bound to the range checker
checkers: check-gf2-lemire-range.py exact statement, shard, degree-population, status, policy, producer, and measurement checks
gf2::check_irreducible_certificate bit-packed Frobenius and Bezout identity replay
gf2_independent::check_irreducible_certificate_independent dense-coefficient replay sharing neither polynomial representation nor arithmetic with the primary checker
evidence.notes: Fleet completion supplies no credit. The range checker requires the exact 400-row population, and each referenced child is content-bound and replayed by both algebraically separate checkers. The sparse search policy found 227 trinomials, 172 pentanomials, and degree-one x after 38,679 candidates; those are measurements, not assumptions of the proposition. The universal conjecture is deliberately absent from this fact.

provenance.established_by: gf2-lemire lane: deterministic untrusted fleet search plus exact population checking and two independent irreducibility certificate checkers
provenance.source: Daniel Lemire's conjecture, restricted to the independently checked finite interval 1 through 400
provenance.prior_art: Daniel Lemire and Owen Kaser, Strongly universal string hashing is fast, The Computer Journal 57(11), 2014, Section 4.1 and footnote 4, https://arxiv.org/abs/1202.4961

notes: The status is computed rather than proved because this is a finite witness family on the search-certificate route, not a kernel theorem or a universal CAS identity. The external status refers only to this bounded proposition, which the committed witnesses independently re-establish.
